flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi helpers/RevivalBaseHelper (updateSuspendedNoticeRevival, updateDatabaseAfterRevivalAll, clearVONSuspension, revertCompositionAmountIfReduced), helpers/{TemporaryRevivalHelper,PermanentRevivalHelper}, crud/ocmsizdb/suspendednotice/SuspendedNoticeRepository (updateRevivalFieldsNative), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsReduction. Other repos: no code. Maintenance: OCMS-DF-2026-028, -029, -072, -078.
note: Story status is 'No requirement' (requirement not given); traced normally. Revival uses a native UPDATE on the ocms_suspended_notice row (date_of_revival, revival_reason, revival_remarks, officer_authorising_revival); there is no delete statement in RevivalBaseHelper, TemporaryRevivalHelper or PermanentRevivalHelper, so the suspension and reduction history stays and can still be read through /plus-suspended-notice. The VON and eVON are cleared or filled from the remaining active suspension. For a reduction (TS-RED), amount_payable is restored from the latest ocms_reduced_offence_amount record and that record itself is not changed. Gaps: the amount restore is skipped when crs_reason=FP, when there is no record, or when amount_payable is empty, and an error during the revert is only logged while the revival still succeeds (RevivalBaseHelper.java:919-923). The original pre-reduction value is only filled since OCMS-DF-2026-072 (closed, Prod deployed); the revert from the wrong source was fixed in OCMS-DF-2026-028 (closed), and OCMS-DF-2026-078 patched 4 TS-RED notices left with a wrong amount, so older data from before the fix may have no original value. Payment fields for court stages were fixed in OCMS-DF-2026-029 (closed). Next Processing Date is deliberately not changed on revival (:758-759); whether a cron processes the notice again cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Can be claimed for reviving without deleting history. The claims 'reduction reverted' and 'notice processed again' are only partial: the amount revert has skip conditions and swallows errors, and reprocessing depends on a cron that cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS marks the suspension as revived without deleting the old row
steps.detail: updateRevivalFieldsNative runs UPDATE ... SET date_of_revival, revival_reason, revival_remarks, officer_authorising_revival WHERE notice_no, date_of_suspension, sr_no (SuspendedNoticeRepository.java:161-172). There is no delete in the three revival helpers; the row can still be read through plus-suspended-notice.

steps.step: OCMS updates the VON and eVON after the revival
steps.detail: If active suspensions remain, the VON/eVON are filled from the remaining ones; if not, suspension_type, epr_*, crs_* and due_date_of_revival are cleared (clearVONSuspension :320-355).

steps.step: OCMS reverts the reduction (TS-RED) without deleting the reduction record
steps.detail: amount_payable on the VON and eVON is restored from the latest ocms_reduced_offence_amount record; the reduction record is not changed. Skipped when crs_reason=FP (:868-872), when the record or amount is empty (:880-891), and an exception is only logged while the revival still succeeds (:919-923). Depends on the fixes OCMS-DF-2026-072/-028/-078; data from before the fixes cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The notice can be processed again by OCMS
steps.detail: Next Processing Date is deliberately not changed on revival; the code assumes a cron picks up notices with a past NPD. For PS, payment_acceptance_allowed is set to Y and eservice_message_code is set (:333-349); TS does not change those fields. Execution of the reprocessing cron cannot verify from repo; court-stage payment fields were fixed in OCMS-DF-2026-029.
